_comment: Same key structure as pt.json (the canonical structure — see scripts/lib/i18n.mjs). No pt_only section: the 'Antes de preencher' framing block is Portuguese-only by design (spec v2, section 1.2).

errors.email_invalido: Enter a valid email address, for example name@email.com.
errors.nif_invalido: Enter a valid Portuguese tax number (NIF), 9 digits.
errors.codigo_postal_invalido: Enter a postal code in the format 0000-000.
errors.matricula_invalida: Enter a valid Portuguese vehicle plate.
errors.data_inicio_invalida: The start date cannot be before today.

success.corpo: Thank you. We'll review your request and reply within 24 business hours.
